notes.title: A new leaf for Tunnel-B1
notes.notes:
Great news for all of you fans out there hoping to see Tunnel-B1 thrive into the future! 

Tunnel-B1 Is now in the capable hands of Throwback Entertainment and in the same wheel house as Extreme-G 2, Trickstyle and Gladiator: Sword of Vengeance. 

At Throwback Entertainment, we have a passion for retro gaming and aim to propel the classics back into the world of old and new fans.

Tunnel-B1 is very much alive so keep an eye out for an update in the near future that will smooth out the game play making a more enjoyable experience! 

We would like to thank Piko Interactive for getting this great game out to it's fans and passing the torch in trust to us to continue the Tunnel-B1 legacy. 

We hope to continue to see your feedback and look forward to an engaged community.

-Throwback Entertainment
